messages:
aaron: starting rollout for release v2.3.1 now. plan: enable feature flag skill_rerank in prod at 5% -> 20% -> 50% with 10m holds. keeping model pin to v2.2 for fallback. deploy-bot: deploy started: release/v2.3.1 -> prod (job 67821). will toggle flags per schedule. maya: quick ask — primary metrics to watch? latency P50/P95 and error-rate on rerank endpoint? lin h: (typo) linh: +1 on p95 and 95th token latency, also embedding qps. recommend initial hold 15min at 5% instead of 10m given new quantization changes. sam: noted. can we shadow traffic to compare outputs? jessica: we have eval set for rerank — will run against shadow for first 5m and post delta. deploy-bot: flag skill_rerank toggled -> 5% at 1938500042. oncall-bot: alert config applied: watch p95 > 1200ms or error-rate delta > 0.5% -> page. maya: watching dashboards now. lin h: command to pin fallback model if needed: `rwctl model pin --env prod --route rerank --model redwood/v2.2` sam: seeing small p95 uptick ~40ms at 5% after 30s. not alarming yet. jessica: eval diff after 3m: relevance +0.8%, hallucination unchanged. sending short report. aaron: keep rolling at planned cadence unless metrics exceed thresholds. lin h: hold at 5% for 15m per my suggestion. we'll then go to 20% for 10m. deploy-bot: scheduled next toggle -> 20% at 1938500942. sam: heads-up — right around 4m we see a subset of requests with retry loop in logs, example:
```
2026-06-15T12:04:21Z rerank_req id=abc123 retry=1 reason=kvcache-miss
2026-06-15T12:04:21Z rerank_req id=abc123 latency=1420ms
```
sam: that second line is from 1% of sample. lin h: hmm kvcache-miss spike could be due to the new kernel selection for quantized paths. jessica: eval still looks good for outputs, but perf hit might be real. aaron: decision time: hold at 5% until we triage further. do not proceed to 20%. maya: agreed. flip flag back to 0%? or keep 5% and pin fallback? lin h: prefer to roll back flag to 0% to stop risk surface, then pin model to v2.2 on the rerank route for safe state. we can re-run perf experiments on staging for kernel selection. sam: ok executing: `/ff toggle skill_rerank off --env prod --note "hold due to p95 volatility"` deploy-bot: flag skill_rerank toggled -> 0% at 1938500189. oncall-bot: incident note created: INC-2026-71 "skill_rerank perf variance during rollout". aaron: good. please also add a short release note entry explaining we paused rollout for performance investigation. jessica: adding to release notes: "Rollout paused — skill_rerank: performance variance observed; investigating kv cache interaction with quantized kernel selection. No user-facing correctness regressions detected." sam: pinned model: `rwctl model pin --env prod --route rerank --model redwood/v2.2 --reason "rollback after perf spike"` -> success. deploy-bot: model pin applied at 1938500254. lin h: raising a follow-up ticket for runtime team to reproduce kvcache-miss pattern under load. aaron: assign to @linh and @sam, timeline 2d. maya: thanks all — created a short postmortem draft and linked dashboards. :thumbsup: jessica: will re-run evals once kernel patch lands. aaron: closing thread for now. we will regroup before next rollout attempt.
